tei:div.tei:p: 485)༄༅/ rdo rje phag mo'i sgrub thabs kyi mtshams 'dug las 'grigs bsdus pa gsal bar bkod pa bzhugs so// 486)

bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ de la 'dir phag mo'i sgrub thabs rdo rje'i rgya can gyi bsnyen sgrub ji ltar bya ba'i tshul las 'grigs su bkod pa la/ thog mar gnas khang yo byad sogs gnad yig ltar bya chen/ bsham bkod kyi rim pa la/ dkyil 'khor lding khri gsum pa stegs khebs dang ldan par byas te/ dang po la rtsa gsum chos skyong nor lha rnams kyi gtor ma 'god/ bsdu na rtsa gsum kun 'dus gtor ma rin chen 'bar ba bshams/ gnyis pa la/ dkyil 'khor sgo rdzogs ras bris sam/ yang na tshom bu lha grangs bkod cing*/ de steng lha gang yin gyi sgos 487) sgrub gtor ma dang*/ de'i g.yas su chad tho/ g.yon du brtan ma/ dregs pa rnam gsum gyi gtor ma/ gzhan yang dngos grub kyi rdzas/ bum pa/ sku tsaka mtshan ldan bhandhar bdud rtsi/ byin ldan gyi ril bu/ me long*/ shel rdo rnams bshams/ mdun du mchod rdzas sman raka gtor gsum/ rdzas ldan gyi rnam lnga rgyun bshams can dang*/ yang*/ nyin re bzhin gshegs bshams byed rgyu'i rnam lnga rnams bshams dgos/ gsum pa la/ tshogs mchod kyi yo byad bzhag cing drag po yin na smad las kyi rim pa sogs bshams dgos/ bsdu na gtor sgrom gyi nang du bang rim gnyis po gong bzhin bya zhing gsum pa med kyang rung*/ de ltar rgyas bsdus gang yin kyang yar ngo'i gza' skar 'phrod sbyor 'dzoms pa'i nyin/ gzhung bzhin sta gon legs par bsgrigs mthar/ nub ja gsol rjes/ hūm̐ hrīḥ sngon gyi bskal pa'i sogs nas/ brlab tu gsol bar dang*/ sku gsum gsol 'debs/ 488)e ma hoḥ spros bral chos kyi sogs/ bar chad lam sel/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: chos sku snang ba sogs/ pha la hūm̐: e ma ho/ mtsho dbus ge sar sogs/ o rgyan rin po che sogs/ hrīḥ dkon mchog tsa gsum sogs/ skyabs gnas bslu med sogs/ sku phreng gsol 'debs/ e ma hoḥ dbyings dang ye shes sogs/ skye ba kun tu sogs/

spyi gces sngon 'gro'i 'jug sgo las/ rdor gsor dril 'dzin/ rang nyid skad cig sogs/ hūm̐ dzñā na badzra hrīḥ rdo rje thugs kar gsor/ hūm̐ dzñā na badzra g.yon bsgyur bkan/ dril bu dkur brten/ mum̐: 'khyud rgya dang dril gsil bya/ rdor gsor dril 'dzin/ rang dam tshig sogs/ badzra sa ma ya: bsdu rgya se gol/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sgo bzhi'i rgya smin gling ltar dang*/ ḍā 'ur/ ḍā bcas/ hūm̐: sngon gyi sogs nas/ dngos grub stsol: ḍā bcad/ ḍā 'ur/ sngags rol/ ḍā nyis bcad/ rdor gsor dril 'dzin/ oṃ swa bha wa sogs/ bsil/ bsams te: gsil/ oṃ āḥ sogs/ nyin dang por nyer gcig dang*/ rgyun du bdun brjod/ sngags rjes mar gsil/ rdor gsor dril 'dzin/ slar yang sogs bsang chu byin brlabs bya/ rdor gsor dril 'dzin/ bsang chu mchod rdzas/ a mṛ ta dang*/ swā bha wa sogs gsil/ rdor thal dril 'dzin/ stong pa'i 489) sogs/ gyur: oṃ badzra arghaṃ sogs/ mchod rol/ gnas dang mchod pa'i sogs/ mkha' 'gro'i gsol 'debs zab mo/ e ma ho: chos nyid sogs/ shog: rang gi snying ga 'i sogs/ dzaḥ bsdu rgya nges gol/ sgrub thabs las/ skyabs sems rdor thal dril 'dzin bcas/ na mo: gzhi dbyings sogs/ bskyed do: lan gsum/ yan bdun/ hoḥ ye shes sogs/ āḥhūm̐: mchod rol/ tshogs zhing bsdu/ dkar gtor las/ pad skor rang rgya/ nam mdzod sngags dang gcig hūm̐/ mchod sbyin sogs/ khā hiḥ na mo: bdag gi sogs/ gyur cig mchod rol/ mtshams lha bskyed pa las/ oṃ hrīḥpadma kro ta= bstim mo: ḍā 'ur/ ḍā bcad/ hūm̐ hrīḥ ye shes sogs/ sha ya hūm̐: ḍā bcad/ swa bhā wa sogs/ gsil/ stong pa sogs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: rang rgya/ rdor dril bcas/ sarba bhu ta gsum/ 'gugs rgya dang*/ sam bha ra gsum/ bsngo rgya se gol/ sgrub thabs las bka' bsgo/ ḍā 'ur/ ḍā bcas/ hūm̐ hrīḥ nga ni sogs/ phaṭaḥ ḍā bcad/ hūm̐ bzhi dang drag sngags mjug ḍā 'ur/

ḍā bcas/ hūm̐: rang byung sogs/ bstan: ḍā bcad/ bsrung dmigs bzung nas rdor skor dril bu gsil bzhin/ badzra rakṣa sogs/ 490) 'dir rgyal tho 'jog rdor thal dril 'dzin/ hūm̐: rang rig sogs/ shuddhe āḥ gsil/ rdor thal bzhi dril/ rang rta/ āḥ rnam thar sogs/ chen por gsal: ḍā bcas/ hūm̐ hrīḥ rnga yab sogs/ du gsol: ḍā bcad/ oṃ badzra sogs/ ḍā 'ur/ ḍā bcas/ hūm̐ hrīḥ ka dag sogs/ lhan: ḍā bcad nas bzhag rdor thal dril 'dzin/ na mo: bde gshegs sogs/ sha ya ho: bsil/ rdor thal dril 'dzin/ hūm̐ hrīḥ gdod nas sogs/ sa stsol: gsil/ rdor dril med par pad skor rang rgya/ oṃ badzra sogs/ khā hiḥ bsdu rgya/ se gol/ mchod rol/ rdor dril bcas spyi phyag rtsa gdangs/ hrīḥ ye nas sogs/ bstod: mchod rol/ rdor thal dril 'dzin/ hoḥ rgyal yum sogs/ gsol: yig brgya/ ḍā 'ur/ bzhag thabs/ 'dzab bskul gsol 'debs/ hūm̐ badzra phaṭa kyis dzab khang dbye/ ḍā 'ur/ ḍā bcas/ rang rta/ hriḥ rang nyid mkha' 'gro'i sogs/ bzlas: ḍā 'ur/ nyis bcad/ mtshams sbyar las phreng ba byin brlabs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: brgya rtsa/ oṃ badzra bha ra sogs/ 'dzab dbyangs lan bdun gyi mthar/ mtshams 491) sbyar las/ rtsa gsum rgyal ba'i sogs/ dbyangs gsal/ yig brgya/ rten snying*/ 'dod gsol/ hoḥ rgyal yum rdo rje phag mo'i sogs/ ḍā bcas/ hoḥ dngos su 'byor dang sogs/ ḍā 'ur bcas phyi nang gsang ba'i sngags rnams 'don/ ḍā bcas/ hrīḥ ye nas sogs/ sa bstod: dge ba 'di yis sogs ḍā 'ur bzhag thabs/ tshogs kyi mjug gi bshags pa/ hoḥ ma 'byor pa dang sogs/ gsol/ yig brgya gcig bsngo ba/ smon lam gsum/ rten bzhugs/ gshegs bsdu/ bkra shis/ bsngo smon sogs grub mthar gnyied kyi rnal 'byor la 'jug go/ ༈ dngos gzhi'i nyin nangs ja gsol mthar/ thun dang po ngag byin brlabs dang*/ zab lam bla ma'i rnal 'byor skal ldan lam grol 'don mthar/ dpal ldan rtsa ba'i sogs/

dpal bla ma'i sogs/ hūm̐ hrīḥ ma lus sems can sogs/ gshegs su gsol: hūm̐ hrīḥ sngon gyi bskal pa'i sogs/ siddhi hūm̐: gnas mchog 'di ru sogs/ bcom ldan 'dir ni sogs/ 'dir ni gzugs dang sogs/ sa gzh-i spos chus sogs/ sku gsum yongs rdzogs sogs/ sa bla ma sku khams sogs/ e ma hoḥ spros bral chos kyi sogs sku gsum gsol 'debs/ e ma hoḥ 492)nub phyogs bde ba sogs/ e ma hoḥ rgyal kun dgongs pa sogs/ hūm̐: mtsho dbus ge sar sogs/ o rgyan rin po che la sogs/ lan gsum/ hrīḥ dkon mchog rtsa gsum sogs/ skyabs gnas bslu med sogs/ e ma hoḥ khyab bdag gdod ma'i sogs/ shogaḥ sku phreng gsol 'debs byin brlabs thugs rje'i sprin phung las/ e ma hoḥ dbyings dang ye shes sogs/ thob par shog: skye ba kun tu sogs/ las gang byed kyi sngon 'gro'i las bum/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta sogs/ swa bhā wa sogs/ gsil/ stong pa sogs/ gsil/ yig brgya bdun/ sa twa brgya rtsa/ sa oṃ badzra arghaṃ sogs/ shabda pra tītstsha ye swā hāḥ ḍā 'ur/ ḍā bcad/ hūm̐ hrīḥ bde gshegs sogs/ bstod: ḍā 'ur bzung thabs/ lha 'od du sogs/ hrīḥ bde gshegs sogs/ yig brgya bzla zhing kha chab blangs/ ja gsol ba'i rjes dang*/ sgo bzhengs sogs kyi rjes su kha chab blang dgos/ spyi gces sngon 'gro las/ rdor gsor dril 'dzin bcas/ rang nyid skad cig gi sogs/ hūm̐ dzñā na badzra hriḥ rdo rje thugs kar gsor/ hūm̐ dzñā na badzra g.yon bsgyur bkan gyis dril bu dkur bsten/ muṃḥ'akhyud rgya dang dril gsil bya/ rdor gsor dril 'dzin/ rang dam tshig sogs/ sa badzra sa ma ya bsdu rgya se gol/ sa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sgo bzhi'i rgya smin gling ltar dang*/ ḍā 'ur/ ḍā bcas 493)hūm̐: sngon gyi sogs/ sa dngos grub stsol/ ḍā bcad ḍā 'ur/ sngags rol 'og ḍā nyis bcad bya/ cho ga spyi'i mtshams sbyar la/ bsang chu byin rlabs la/

sa rdor gsor dril 'dzin/ sa oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ sa gsil/ stong pa nyid du sogs/ gyur par bsam: gsil la bzhag sngags bdun gyi rjes mar gsil la/ sa lha de nyid sogs/ mjug ga ི a mṛ ta nas gsil bzhi/ bsang chu byin brlabs bya/ mchod rdzas byin brlabs la/ rdor gsor dril 'dzin/ a mṛ ta dang*/ swa bha wa gnyis kyi mjug tu gsil/ mchod rdzas rnams kyi sogs/ mnyam par gyur: gsil nas bzhag ste/ rdor dril med par pad skor rang rgya/ oṃ su ra sogs/ pra tītstsha ye swā hāḥ bsdu rgya se gol/ mchod rol 'ur chem ring thung gnyis can/ sa snying thig las 'ur rjes ma cung zad thung*/ ma hā sarba pañtsa sogs rang rgya/ swā hāḥ ma hā sarba pū dzaḥ bsdu rgya/ mchod rol/ spos phyung la rdor thal dril 'dzin/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: ngo bo sogs/ shu dho ni shuddhe sogs nas/ hūm̐:gi bar gsil/ mchod rol/ brgyud 'debs/ e ma hoḥ chos nyid sogs/ shog: mtshams sbyar las/ skyabs yul bskyed pa/ oṃ ma hā shu n+ya ta sogs/ 494)bstim mo: rdor dril bcas bsdu rgya se gol bcas/ phag mo'i sgrub thabs las/ skyabs sems/ rdor thal dril 'dzin/ rtsa gdangs kyis/ na mo: gzhi dbyings sogs/ sems bskyed do: gsil lan gsum/ yan bdun/ rdor thal dril 'dzin/ sa hoḥ ye shes sogs/ sa bsngo: ratna maṇḍal sogs gsil bzhin nas mchod/ mchod rol maṇḍal med na mchod rol mi dgos/ tshogs zhing bsdu bar/ rdor dril bcas rang rgya/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ tshogs zhing sogs/ gyur: bsdu rgya se gol/ mtshams sbyar las/ dkar gtor byin brlabs la/ pad skor mthar chos nyid rnam dag gi phyag rgya smos pa thal mo snying gar sbyar bzhin/ oṃ swa bha wa sogs/ stong pa'i sogs/ oṃ a ka ro sogs/ gsil/ dkar gtor la/ rdor thal dril 'dzin/ hūm̐: mchod sbyin sogs/ oṃ sarba lo ka sogs la gsil bzhin nas mchod cing*/ dril bu tshig brdung byed bzhin/ na mo: bdag gi bsam pa'i

sogs/ dkar gtor mgron la zhes kha bsgyur nas/ 'byung gyur cig: bar ro/ mchod rol bgegs gtor zur bkol las/ oṃ hrīḥpadma ta krita/ bstim mo: ḍā 'ur chem bcad cing*/ hūm̐ hrīḥ nas ḍā phyir bskor/ dkrol bzhin/ ye shes rol pa sogs/ ḍā dkrol tshul 'og ma rnams la 'di ltar rigs 495) 'gres so/ mjug gi sha ya hūm̐ nas ḍā bcad cing bzhag la/ mtshams sbyar las/ bgegs gtor byin brlabs/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta sogs gsil/ oṃ swa bha wa sogs/ gsil/ bgegs kyi sogs/ gyur: rdor dril med par mkha' lding gi rgya spyi ltar gyi/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: gsum/ ha ho hrīḥ rdor dril bcas 'gugs rgya byed bzhin/ oṃ sarba bhu ta sogs/ lan gsum/ sa rdor dril bcas g.yon bsngo rgya byas te/ g.yas pas bsgyur bkan gyis bsngo rgya re bca' zhing se gol gtogs gzhin/ na maḥsarba sogs lan gsum/ bka' bsgo la/ ḍā 'ur/ ḍā bcas/ hūm̐ hrīḥ nga ni dpal chen sogs/ ta ya phaṭaḥ nas ḍā bcad la/ hūm̐ bzhi dang drag sngags kyi mjug bsdu zhing*/ u tsa ta ya ḍā 'ur bya zhing*/ bsrung 'khor la/ ḍā bcas/ hūm̐: rang byung bde ba sogs/ sa rab tu brtan: nas ḍā bcad cing bzhag bsrung dmigs bzung nas rdor skor dril gsil bcas/ badzra rakṣa sogs sgo byang phyi nang bzhag dam bzung la/ rdor thal dril 'dzin gyis/ hūm̐: rang rig sogs/ mjug gi sngags la gsil/ mtshams sbyar las/ rang gi sogs/ gyur: byin 'bebs la/ ḍā 'ur/ ḍā bcas/ hūm̐ hrīḥ 'og min sogs/ cig: nas ḍā 496) bcad de/ sngags bcas ḍā 'ur/ mchod pa byin brlabs la/ ḍā bcas/ hūm̐: snang ba'i sogs sngags mjug tu mchod rol bya zhing bzhag bshags par rdor thal dril 'dzin bcas/ hūm̐: rang rig sogs/ mjug gi sngags la gsil/ lha bskyed la/ rdor thal bzhi dril/ rang rta bcas/ āḥ rnam thar sogs/ sa chen por gsal: mtshams sbyar las/ rang gi snying ga'i sogs/ dza dzaḥst+wamaḥ ḍā bcas gzhung gi dam tshig lha yi

sogs/ baṃ hoḥ nas ḍā 'ur/ spyan 'dren la/ ḍā bcas/ rang rta/ hūm̐ hrīḥ rnga yab sogs/ sa du gsol: nas ḍā bcad/ sngags bcas ḍā 'ur/ bzhugs gsol la/ ḍā bcas/ hūm̐ hrīḥ ka dag sogs/ tiṣṭha lhan: nas ḍā bcad cing bzhag phyag 'tshal la/ rdor thal dril 'dzin bcas/ na mo: bde gshegs sogs/ mjug gi sngags la gsil/ mchod pa la/ rdor thal dril 'dzin bcas/ sa hūm̐ hrīḥ gdod nas sogs/ dam pa stsol: nas gsil zhing dril bar bya/ rdor dril med par pad skor rang rgya bcas/ oṃ badzra sogs/ khā hiḥ bsdu rgya se gol mchod rol/ mtshams sbyar las/ sman mchod la'ang mdun du bshams pa'i nang mchod kyi sman g.yas pas rdo rje bcas thogs nas/ g.yon dril thal bcas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ḥ chos sku sogs/ 497) mtshams rnams kyi/ a mṛ ta la sogs g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis sman mchod cing*/ khā hiḥ la dril gsil re bya/ dngos grub mjug tu/ mchod rol/ bstod pa la/ rdor dril bcas rigs lnga'i spyi phyag dang*/ yo ga'am/ rtsa gdangs bcas/ hrīḥ ye nas sogs/ phyag 'tshal bstod: mchod rol/ bshags par rdor thal dril 'dzin bcas/ hoḥ rgyal yum sogs/ gsol: yig brgya bzla/ ḍā 'ur chem/ bcad/ bdun brdung mthar bcad/ yang cig bcad pa la bzhag rol du go dgos/ 'dzabā bskul gsol 'debs las/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gdod ma'i mgon po sogs/ grol bar shog: bhrūm̐ badzra phaṭaḥ kyis 'dzab khang dbye/ 'dzab la ḍā 'ur ḍā bcas/ rang rta/ hrīḥ rang nyid sogs/ bzlas: ḍā 'ur/ nyis bcad bya/ mtshams sbyar las/ bgrang phreng byin brlabs/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ phreng ba sogs/ bsam la: thun grol dus su mtshams sbyar las/ rtsa gsum rgyal ba'i sogs/ gcig: rdor gsor dril bu gsil bzhin/ dbyangs gsal/ yig brgya/ rten snying*/ rdor thal dril gsil bcas/ hoḥ rgyal yum rdo rje'i phag mo'i dkyil 'khor sogs/ gsol: mchod par rdor thal dril 'dzin/ hūm̐ hrīḥ gdod nas sogs/ 498)khā hiḥ

mchod rol bstod par spyi phyag rtsa gdangs/ hrīḥ ye nas sogs/ bstod: mchod rol/ tshogs kyi mtha'i bshags pa/ yig brgya/ dbyangs gsal/ rten snying*/ bsngo ba/ smon lam/ gshegs bsdu/ rtsa sngags/ bkra shis bar bya/ ḍā 'ur bzhag thabs/ nyin gung ja gsol/ ༈ thun gnyis par/ tho gsos 'don/ mchod rdzas byin brlabs bsdus pa las/ rdor thal dril 'dzin/ hūm̐: gsang ba bla med

sogs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐:badzra sogs/ mchod rol/ gnas dang mchod pa'i sogs/ gsol 'debs/ e ma hoḥ chos nyid sogs/ sa ya dzaḥ bsdu rgya se gol/ rdor thal dril 'dzin bcas/ skyabs sems/ gsum/ yan bdun/ maṇḍal/ mchod rol/ tshogs zhing bsdu/ bka' bsgo la/ ḍā 'ur ḍā bcas/ hūm̐ hrīḥ nga ni sogs/ nan tsitta āḥ ḍā 'ur byin 'bebs/ hūm̐ hrīḥ 'og min sogs/ ḍā 'ur/ bshags pa/ hūm̐: rang rig sogs nas/ baṃ hoḥ ḍā 'ur/ spyan 'dren/ hūm̐ hrīḥ rnga yab sogs nas/ khā hiḥ ḍā 'ur/ bstod pa/ hrīḥ ye nas sogs/ gsol: yig brgya/ ḍā 'ur bzhag thabs bya/ rdor gsor dril 'dzin/ 'dzab/ hrīḥ rang nyid sogs/ bzlas: mtshams sbyar las bgrang 499) phreng byin brlabs bya/ oṃ badzra sogs/ bsnyen pa bzla/ thun mthar/ rtsa gsum rgyal ba'i sogs/ dbyangs gsal gcig yig brgya gcig ston snying*/ 'dod gsol/ hoḥ rgyal yum rdo rje phag mo'i dkyil 'khor sogs/ ḍā bcas/ mchod pa/ hūm̐ hrīḥ gdod nas sogs/ stsol: mchod sngags bcas/ ḍā 'ur ḍā bcas/ bstod pa/ hrīḥ ye nas sogs/ bstod: dge ba 'di yis myur sogs/ ḍā 'ur bzhag thabs bya/ tshogs bskang la/ bshags pa 'od zer rdzas bskang bcas bya/ mtshams bsgrub la/ gtang rag dus ma gtogs tshogs bsdus mi dgos/ tshogs byin brlabs la/ rdor thal dril 'dzin/ hūm̐ hrīḥ 'khor 'das sogs/ gyur: dril bu gsil bzhin/ ram̐ yam̐ sogs/ hrīḥ lan gsum/ pad skor rang gter ltar dang*/ nam mdzod rgya spyi ltar se gol bcas/ nam mdzod sngags/ spyan 'dren la/ ḍā 'ur ḍā bcas/ las byang spyan 'dren rta/ hūm̐ hrīḥ rnam dag sogs/ gsol: ḍā bcad/ sngags bcas/ ḍā 'ur nyis bcad bya/ bdud rtsi 'bul bar/ rdor thal dril 'dzin/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: dbyings dang sogs/ mjug gi sngags la gsil bzhin bdud rtsi mchod/ tshogs phud la/ ḍā 'ur ḍā bcas/ hūm̐ hrīḥ 'dod yon sogs/ khā hiḥ ḍā 'ur nyis 500) bcad bya/ mtshams sbyar las/ bskang rdzas byin brlabs/

oṃ āḥhūm̐: bskang rdzas sogs/ mnyam par gyur: dril gsil/ pad skor rang rgya se gol bcas nam mdzod sngags lan gsum/ rdor thal dril bu gsil bzhin mchod pa'i sprin gzungs sngags gcig bskang bsdus las ḍā 'ur ḍā bcas/ hūm̐ hrīḥ 'og min sogs/ āḥ ḍā bcad dril bu gsil bzhin/ man ngag yig brgya gsum/ mchod rol/ bshags pa la/ rdor thal dril 'dzin/ hoḥ ye shes sogs/ stsol: dril bu gsil bzhin yig brgya/ mtshams sbyar las/ tshogs 'gugs/ gtor snod sogs/ gyur: rdor dril 'gugs rgya bcas/ na mo: dkon mchog sogs/ khug cig: lan gsum gyi rjes mar ḍā bcad/ sgo bzhi'i sngags bcas ḍā 'ur/ bsgral bar/ ḍā bcas/ hūm̐ hrīḥ kun btags sogs/ bsgral: ḍā bcad/ drag sngags so lnga'i mjug 'di gar/ gnod byed sarba sha truṃ mā ra ya phaṭa: btags pas bsgral/ bstab par/ ḍā 'ur ḍā bcas/ ma rig sogs/ hoḥ gnam phud las/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: ye shes sogs/ dzaḥ ḍā 'ur bzhag thabs bya/ drang par rdor gsor dril 'dzin bya/ hoḥ bla med sogs/ stsol: drang pa rol/ mtsho dbus ge sar sogs/ mtshams sbyar las/ lhag ma byin brlabs/ rdor 501) gsor dril 'dzin/ a mṛ ta gsil/ stong par sogs/ gyur: sngags brjod bzhin/ ḍā 'ur/ lhag mar/ ḍā bcas/ pheṃ bhyo: sngon tshe sogs/ khā hiḥ ḍā 'ur bzhag thabs bya/ ye shes mkha' 'gro'i sogs/ tshogs mchod phul ba'i sogs/ gsol kha la mtshams sbyar gyi bskul ba'i/ e las gnam lcags sogs/ gyur: rdor dril bcas 'gugs rgyab/ na mo: rje btsun sogs/ khug cigaḥ lan gcig rang rgya/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gong gi chos skyong gtor ma byin brlabs/ rdor gsor dril 'dzin/ oṃ swa bha wa sogs/ gsil/ stong pa sogs/ gyur cig: gsil/ sngags drug phyag drug rang rgya/ dregs pa rnam gsum gyi gsol bsdus la/ ḍā 'ur ḍā bcas/ hūm̐ bhyo: ma skyes sogs/ mjug gi sngags lan gsum/ gsol bsdus las/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: ha ho hrīḥ

hūm̐ bhyo: sngon tshe rgyal dbang sogs/ mdzod: nyer lnga sogs skabs dang bstun/ gzhan yang*/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ gser skyems/ rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud sogs/ kyai/ rtsa gsum nor lha sogs/ rgyal ba'i bstan srung sogs/ ḍā bcad dril gsil/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa sogs/ bstod pa la/ ḍā bcas/ 502) bhyo: dus gsum sogs/ bstod: ḍā 'ur bzhag thabs/ sngon tshe o rgyan sogs/ gang zhig yid la sogs/ gang zhig yid la sogs/ bstan pa'i dpal gyur sogs/ ༈ thun gsum par/ mchod rdzas byin brlabs bsdus pa/ mchod rol/ gsol 'debs/ tshogs zhing*/ nang sgrub zab mo las/ rdor thal dril 'dzin/ skyabs sems/ na mo: mchog gsum sogs/ shog: lan gsum/ yan bdun/ hoḥ ye shes mkha' 'gro'i sogs/ hūm̐: mchod rol/ tshogs zhing bsdu/ lha bskyed la/ ḍā 'ur ḍā bcas/ āḥ spros bral zang thal sogs/ baṃ hoḥ ḍā 'ur ḍā bcas/ hūm̐ hrīḥ 'og min sogs/ bstod: ḍā 'ur bzhag thabs/ rdor bskor dril 'dzin/ rang nyid mkha' 'gro'i sogs/ bzla: bsnyen pa bzla zhing thun mthar/ rtsa gsum rgyal ba'i sogs/ dbyangs gsal/ yig brgya gcig rten snying gcig 'dod gsol/ ḍā bcas/ mchod pa/ hūm̐ hrīḥ gdod nas sogs/ stsol: mchod sngags bcas/ ḍā 'ur/ ḍā bcas bstod pa/ hūm̐ hrīḥ chos nyid sogs/ bstod: ḍā 'ur bdun bzhag tshogs kyi bshad pa nas bzung bkra shis yan bya zhing*/ ḍā 'ur bzhag thabs/ nub ja gsol/ ༈ thun bzhi par/ 503) mchod rdzas byin brlabs bsdus pa/ mchod rol/ gsol 'debs/ tshogs zhing*/ nang sgrub kyi skyabs sems nas bzung bsnyen skabs bar thun gsum pa ltar bya/ thun mthar/ mchod bstod/ dge bsngo bcas grub rjes/ ḍā 'ur bzhag thabs/ bskul bar mtshams sbyar las/ rdor dril bcas 'gugs rgya/ na mo: rje btsun sogs/ khug cig: lan gsum gyi rjes mar ḍā bcad ḍā 'ur gang*/ sa dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ ḍā bcas/ hūm̐ hrīḥ dbyings snang sogs/ shog: ḍā bcad/ mtshams sbyar las/

bdag mdun gyi sogs/ gyur: sngags bcas ḍā 'ur/ chad tho/ ḍā bcas gcig hūm̐ bhyo: sngon tshe sogs/ mdzod: ḍā 'ur nyis bcod/ mtshams sbyar/ bshal chu sogs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: gsum la rdor thal dril gsil/ brtan mar/ rdor thal dril 'dzin/ hūm̐: rdo rje sogs/ khā hiḥ mchod rol/ mtshams sbyar las/ rdor dril bcas 'gugs rgya/ na mo: sangs rgyas sogs/ khug cig: ḍā bcad 'ur chem nang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: gnod byed sogs/ bro mnan la/ ḍā bcas/ hūm̐ hriḥ bdag nyid sogs/ nan: ḍā 'ur bzhag thabs/ mtshams sbyar las/ 504) gtor snod kha yar sogs mjug gi sngags la gsil bzhin nas zhus bya/ bdag mdun gyi sogs/ bsam: rdor thal dril 'dzin/ hoḥ dngos su 'byor dang sogs/ mchod: gsil/ rdor dril med/ pad kor rang rgya/ oṃ badzra bha ra hi sogs rang gzhung gi phyi nang gsang mchod kyi sngags mthar/ bsdu rgya se gol/ mchod rol/ mtshams sbyar/ sprul pa'i sogs/ bsam la: bstod par rdor dril bcas spyi phyag rtsa gdangs/ hūm̐ hrīḥ ma bcos spros bral sogs gzhung bstod/ gzhung bstod/ hrīḥ ye nas sogs/ bstod: bka' brgyud bla ma sogs/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa sogs/ bstod par 'os pa sogs/ mchod rol/ mtshams sbyar las/ lha mo rnams sogs/ gyur: bshags par/ rdor thal dril 'dzin/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa sogs nas/ mdzad du gsol/ rdo rje thugs kar gtad cing dril bu gsil bzhin/ yig brgya gcig dbyangs gsal gcig rten snying gcig bsngo ba/ rdor thal dril 'dzin/ hoḥ zag bcas sogs/ sa shog: bsil/ smon lam/ hoḥ ye shes sogs/ shog: gsil/ lan gsum/ oṃ/ 'dir ni rten dang sogs/ swā hāḥ gsil bzhin nas 'thor/ gshegs bsdu la/ rdor bsor dril 'dzin rtsa 505) gdangs/ hoḥ ye shes sogs/ bya'o: rtsa sngags brjod bzhin gsil/ mtshams sbyar las/ rang gi thugs ka'i sogs/ ye dharma sogs bsil/ bkra shis la/ rdor thal dril 'dzin/ hūm̐ hrīḥ ka dag sogs gsil/ bstan pa'i dpal gyur=

gnas 'dir nyin mo sogs nas/ su dza ya: ḍā 'ur bzhag thabs/ de ltar du sogs/ sangs rgyas bstan pa sogs/ kun bzang rdo rje sogs/ na mo gu ru/ bdag gzhan rnams kyi sogs bsngo smon mtha' rgyas su bya'o/ ༈ nyin gnyis pa la/ dkar gtor bgegs gtor gyi rta mgrin bskyed pa spyan 'dren bcas/ rgyal tho dang*/ sgo byang phyi nang rnams 'don mi dgos/ de min sngar nyin ltar ro/ de ltar zla ba gcig gi dbang du byas nas bsnyen pa zhag bcu' ma de'i 'gros yin te/ bcu gcig nyin bsnyen pa stong rtsa grub rjes/ nye bsnyen gyi dmigs rim bzung nas rtsa sngags bzla zhing thun skabs su mchod bstod sngar bzhin de'i 'gres yin/ khyon nyi ma bcu bzhi 'gro dgos kyang*/ bsnyen grangs ma song na nyi ma cha shas bsnan kyang chog gsungs/ bsnyen pa zhag bcu bzhi'i dbang du byas pas/ bsgrub 506) dus nyin bco lnga bar sngar bzhin/ 'dzab kyi mthar/ thun bzhi gar bhrūm̐ badzra phaṭaḥ kyis dzab kha dbye dgos/ bsnyen 'dzab bsnyen pa stong rtsa re dang*/ nye bsnyen dmigs pa bcas lnga brgya grub rjes sgrub pa/ sgrub chen/ las sbyor rnams la/ nyin dang po rnams su/ ye shes lha tshogs spyan 'dren sogs kyis bstod dgos/ de phan chad mi dgos/ mtshams sbyar las/ rang gi snying ga'i sogs/ brlabs par gyur: bsgrub pa'i nyin dang por 'dzab bskul gsol 'debs lan gcig tsam du 'don zhing*/ de phan chad 'dir mi dgos pas de yang ḍā 'ur ḍā bcas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: gdod ma'i mgon po sogs/ shog: rtsa gsum spyi gces dngos grub len chog las/ ḍā 'ur ḍā bcas/ hūm̐ hrīḥ ka dag skye med sogs/ stsol: ḍā bcad/ ḍā 'ur/ sngags rol/ ḍā nyis bcad bya zhing bzhag ye shes dbab pa'i sogs/ bsam la: thun bzhi ru de ltar 'don dgos/ de nas sgrub 'dzab la 'jug 'dzab med na dmigs rim gyis dbye zhing*/ bsnyen sngags bzlas/ thun skabs mchod bstod sogs nas las mtha' rgyas su sngar bzhin zhag bdun du de'i 'gres so/

zhag nyer gnyis nyin/ bsgrub sngags 507) lnga brgya bzlas mthar/ sgrub pa chen po la/ 'dzab bskul dang*/ sgrub 'dzab dang phod na 'don/ med tshe dmigs rim gyis dbye nas bsnyen sngags bzla/ mthar mchod bstod sogs nas las mtha' rgyas su sngar bzhin zhag ma lnga de'i 'gres so/ de nas zhag nyer bdun pa las sbyor nyin/ sngar ltar sgrub chen sngags lnga brgya bzlas mthar/ thun dang po zhi ba'i dmigs rim bzung nas rtsa sngags bzla zhing*/ thun mthar rtsa sngags dang 'brel bar zhi sham bdun re bzla/ 'di nyin nas bzung*/ phrin las rab 'byams thams cad thogs pa med par lhun gyis 'grub par gyur cig dbyangs gsal/ yig brgya/ rten snying*/ 'dod gsol sogs nas sngar bzhin no/ thun gnyis par rgyas pa'i dmigs rim dang*/ rgyas sham bdun/ gsum par dbang dang*/ dbang sham bdun dang*/ bzhi par drag po dang*/ drag sham bdun sogs bzla/ de gar bsnyen bsgrub las sbyor rnams zla ba gcig gi dbang du byas nas song ba'i mthar/ nangs snga las byang gzhung gong ltar 'don nas bsnyen pa stong rtsa/ byin 'bebs sgrub pa lnga brgya/ las sbyor sum brgya tsam grub pa dang*/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i bskyed sngags kyis las bum bsgrub/ 508) mchod bstod/ las lha 'od zhu/ dge bsngo/ gsol kha 'dir bya/ bshags pa che chung skabs dang bstun/ tshogs mchod lhag ma yan gong bzhin grub mthar/ ༈ ye shes mkha' 'gro'i me mchod la/ gzhung bzhin de dkyil bsregs rdzas bsham bkod sogs grub mthar/ byin brlabs la/ rdor gsor dril 'dzin/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta sogs gsil/ oṃ swa bha wa sogs gsil/ sa rdzas rnams la las chu bran bzhin/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: dril bu gsil bzhin/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum/ bsregs 'don/ ḍā cung zad dkrol nas/ snang srid dpal yon sogs/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ sogs/ ḍā 'ur/ mchod rol/ me sbar la/ rdor dril med par rdo rje rtse gcig gi phyag rgyas me sgron bzung zhing*/

mar/ yam shing*/ rdzas 'dus sogs la reg bzhin/ oṃ agne sogs kyis me thab kyi kong bu sbar/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gyis rlung g.yab/ 'di man chad bsregs 'don kho na/ ḍā bcas/ hūm̐: ye shes rtsal las sogs/ med par gyur: ḍā bcad/ rdor dril bcas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang rgya bca'/ spyan 'dren/ ḍā 'ur/ ḍā bcas/ sa hūm̐ hrīḥ rnga yab sogs/ gsol: ḍā bcad/ ḍā 'ur sngags rol/ ḍā bcas/ 509) bzhugs gsol/ sa hūm̐ hrīḥ ka dag sogs/ lhan: ḍā bcad nas bzhag phyag 'tshal/ rdor thal dril 'dzin/ sa na mo: bde gshegs sogs/ sngags la gsil/ mchod pa/ rdor thal/ dril 'dzin/ hūm̐ hrīḥ gdod nas sogs/ stsol: gsil/ rdor dril med par pad skor rang rgya bcas/ oṃ badzra bha ra hi haḥri ṇi sa pa ri wa ra badzra arghaṃ pa tītstsha ye swā hā/ brnol rgya se gol phyir gdab/ de bzhin du padyam̐ sogs nas/ shapda'i bar sbyar zhing*/ mchod rol/ pad skor rang rgya/ sa oṃ badzra sogs/ ru pa pra tītstsha ye swā hā/ se gol gong ltar/ shabda sogs nas/ dharma'i bar dang*/ mchod rol/ pad skor rang rgya/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ sogs/ wa ra ma hā sarba pañtsa sogs/ khā hiḥ se gol/ mchod rol/ byon skyems la/ rtsa sngags mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ḥsarba sogs/ bdun re'i mthar/ mchod rol/ byon nyer gcig rdzas rnams 'bul bar/ sa rdor thal dril bcas/ hūm̐ hrīḥ ka dag sogs/ stsol: gsil/ mar khu la/ rtsa sngags mthar/ oṃ a mṛ ta sogs/ swā hā: bdun re'i mthar/ 'dod gsol/ hoḥ rdo rje phag mo'i sogs/ mdzod cig: mchod rol/ de'i 'gres kyi nyer gcig mthar/ yams 510) shing la/ rtsa sngags dang*/ oṃ bho dhi sogs/ sham bcas lan nyer gcig bdun mtshams su 'dod gsol dang*/ mchod rol/ rdzas 'dus 'bul bar/ rdor thal dril bcas/ hūm̐ḥ sangs rgyas spyan ma'i sogs/ stsol: gsil/ rtsa sngags mthar/ ma hā sarba khā hiḥ sham bcas nyer gcig gi mtshams su 'dod gsol dang*/ mchod rol/ lnga bcu'i mthar/ 'dod gsol/ mchod rol/

brgya rtsa'i mtshams su 'dod gsol/ mchod rol/ de'i 'gros kyis bsnyen pa'i kha skong tsam man/ rtsa sngags dang*/ rdzas sngags gnyis la grangs bzung na sham bu med kyang chog par gsungs/ de gar ji rigs song mthar/ thun skabs su 'og gi bstod pa tshig bzhi dang*/ mchod rol/ bsngo smon/ bkra shis tsam grub rjes/ rang gzhung gi bshags pa/ bsngo smon/ nyer bsdu sogs thun skabs kyi rnal 'byor sngar bzhin bya'o/ thun rjes ma la/ tho gsos/ mchod rdzas byin brlabs sogs nas/ bdag bskyed bsdug pa las byang gnyis pa ltar 'don nas/ mchod bstod dge bsngo'i mthar/ me mchod las/ ḍā bcas/ hūm̐:

ye shes rtsal las gong ltar 'don nas/ mchod pa'i mjug gi sngags rang gzhung gar bsdus pa bya zhing phyag rgya med par/ mchod rol/ byon skyems yang 511) mi dgos/ rdzas 'bul la/ hūm̐ hrīḥ ka dag sogs/ stsol: mar khu la/ rtsa sngags dang*/ oṃ a mṛ ta sogs/ swā hāḥ bdun mthar/ 'dod gsol/ mchod rol/ yams shing la/ rtsa sngags dang*/ oṃ bo dhi sogs sham bcas bdun/ 'dod gsol/ mchod rol/ rdzas 'dus la/ hūm̐: sangs rgyas sogs/ stsol: rtsa sngags mthar/ ma hā sarba sogs sham bcas/ nyer gcig sogs na gong ltar grangs bzung zhing*/ dgung mo rdzas rnams rdzogs dang*/ gos zung 'bul ba/ rdor thal dril bcas/ hūm̐ hrīḥ srab 'jam sogs/ stsol: gsil rtsa sngags dang*/ oṃ badzra sogs/ swā hāḥ mchod rol/ so rtsi/ hūm̐ hrī: ye shes sogs/ gsol: gsil/ oṃ badzra sogs/ swā hāḥ mchod rol/ bstod pa spyi phyag rtsa gdangs bcas/ hūm̐ hrīḥ ye nas chos nyid sogs/ bstod: mchod rol/ gtang rag la/ rdor thal dril bcas/ oṃ dngos 'byor sogs/ stsol: gsil/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ sogs/ mchod rol bcas/ khā hi'i bar dang*/ gshegs skyems la/ rdor thal dril bcas/ hūm̐/ dbyings dang sogs/ stsol: gsil/ rtsa sngags dang*/ sarba pañtsa 512) sogs/ bdun mtshams su/ mchod rol nyer gcig mthar/ mar khu la/ rtsa sngags dang*/ oṃ a mṛ ta swā hāḥ sham mi dgos/ lan bdun/ 'dod gsol/ hoḥ rje btsun rdo rje phag mo'i sogs/ gtang rag gi mchod pa zhes kha bsgyur bya/ mchod rol/ yams shing la/ rtsa sngags dang*/ oṃ bo dhi lan bdun/ 'dod gsol/ mchod rol/ rdzas 'dus la/ rtsa sngags dang*/ ma hā sarba sogs/ khā hiḥ lan bdun/ 'dod gsol/ mchod rol/ bstod par/ rdor thal dril bcas/ hūm̐: skye med sogs/ bstod: mchod rol/ dngos grub la rdor gsor dril 'dzin/ hūm̐: byin brlabs sogs/ gsol: gsil/ sngags brjod bzhin dngos grub rol/ mchod rol/ lhag chad kha bskangs/ rdor thal dril bcas/

hūm̐: chad pa dang ni sogs/ stsol: rdo rje thugs kar gtad cing dril bu gsil bzhin yig brgya lan gsum/ gshegs gsol rdor gsor dril 'dzin/ hūm̐: ye shes sogs/ badzra mum̐: se gol gdab cing*/ ye shes pa sogs/ bsam: gsil/ bsngo smon la/ rdor thal dril bcas/ hoḥ zin par shog: gsil/ lan gsum/ bkra shis/ rdor thal/ ye dharma sogs/ gsil/ 513)legs tshogs yon tan sogs/ shog: gsil/ gzhan yang*/ bstan pa'i dpal gyur sogs/ gnas 'dir nyin mo sogs nas/ su dza ya/ ḍā 'ur bzhag thabs/ de ltar du sogs/ de'i 'gros kyis me mchod 'bum phrag kha skong dang bcas pa 'don dgos pas/ nyin snga ma rnams su nub ja gsol ba'i rjes su/ bskul ba chad brtan sogs 'don/ me mchod 'bul tshar ba'i nub mo ja ma gsol gong du bskul pa chad brtan sogs mtha' rgyas su song mthar/ nub ja gsol ba'i rjes su/ tshig bdun gsol 'debs lan gsum/ gra 'don gyis/ hūm̐: bzhengs shig padma 'byung gnas sogs/ dngos grub len chog las/ ḍā 'ur ḍā bcas/ hūm̐ hrīḥ ka dag skye med sogs/ stsol: ḍā bcad/ ḍā 'ur sngags rol/ ḍā nyis bcad bya/ ye shes dbab pa'i sogs/ bsam la: rtsa sngags mthar/ ka ya siddhi sogs/ hrīḥ ces brgya rtsa brjod bzhin/ dngos grub kyi rdzas rnams kha gso zhing*/ sku bum pa/ gsung bdud rtsi/ thugs ril bu/ yon tan phrin las 'ja' shel me long*/ yongs rdzogs bsgrub pa'i gtor ma bcas ma 'chol bar tshul bzhin du bkod la/ ye shes lha tshogs sogs/ bstsal dugasol: ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hī/ ma hā rakta khā hiḥ ma hā ba lingta khā hiḥ 514) mchod rol/ bsam lhun che chung ci rigs mthar/ de nas/ bdag gzhan ma sogs rgyun srol bsngo smon bya'o/ nangs snga tho rangs dang por gdan las bzhengs te/ ngag byin brlabs dang*/ zab lam bla ma'i rnal 'byor sogs nas/ mtshams sbyar bcas las byang 'dzab bstod yan rgyas par grub mthar/ bsnyen pa/

nye bsnyen gnyis la stong rtsa/ byin 'bebs/ sgrub pa/ sgrub chen la lnga brgya/ las sbyor sum brgya/ mchod bstod dge bsngo/ tho gsos/ bshags pa ye 'od rdzas bskang nas bzung mtshams sbyar bcas tshogs kyi drangs pa'i 'go bar du 'don mthar/ mtshams sbyar las/ rang gi snying ga'i sogs/ gyur: ḍā 'ur/ ḍā bcas/ 'dzab bskul gsol 'debs 'don/ mchan/ ḍā 'ur/ ḍā bcas/ hūm̐: bzhengs shig sogs/ gsol: rtsa sngags mthar/ badzra sa ma ya dza dzaḥ e a ra li pheṃ pheṃ: ḍā 'ur/ ḍā bcas/ rang gzhung gi byin 'bebs/ hūm̐ hrīḥ 'og min khyab brdal sogs/ cig: ḍā bcas 'ur sngags rol 'og bzhag thabs/ rtsa sngags mthar/ kā ya siddhi sogs/ hrīḥ brgya rtsa song mthar/ mchod rol/ mtshams sbyar las sman mchod 'don/ bla ma rig 'dzin rgyal ba sogs/ sa ma dzaḥ nyams chags bskang ba'i lung byang las/ 515)hoḥ dus gsum sangs rgyas sogs/ stsol: badzra sa ma dzaḥ btags pa'i yig brgya nyer gcig mthar/ mdun bskyed kyi lha tshogs rnams rjes chags kyis sbyor ba mdzad pa'i bde ba'i sgras bskul bas/ mkha' dbyings gang ba'i rgyal ba thams cad 'dus te byang chub sems kyi ngo bor zhu nas char bzhin babs te sku yi cha shas kun tu mtsho ltar 'khyil ba'i gnas so so nas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad sku phyag rgya/ gsung yig 'bru/ thugs phyag mtshan gyi rnam pa dang*/ zag med bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin byang chub sems kyi sems 'ja' 'od kha dog lnga ldan gyi rnam par bun long long byon nas/ bdag bskyed kyi gnas bzhir thim pas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa thob ste/ bsgrub bya dang sgrub byed dbyer med kyi ngo bor lhun gyis grub par bsam la/ dngos grub len chog las/ rdor gsor dril 'dzin/ hoḥ chos nyid 'gyur med sogs/ gsol: gsil bzhin/ rtsa sngags mthar/ kā ya sogs/ hrīḥ sgrub rdzas gnas gsum du btugs shing dngos grub blangs/

sgrub gtor thogs nas/ gzhung gi dngos grub ni/ rdor gsor dril 'dzin/ hoḥ skye med ka dag sogs/ pha la hūm̐: brjod cing gsil bzhin gnas gsum du 516) du gtugs la rol/ de nas tshogs kyi drangs pa sogs nas lhag ma yan btang mthar/ ye shes mkha' 'gro'i sogs nas/ tshogs mchod phul ba'i sogs/ dngos grub bstsal ba'i gtang rag tu mchod bstod bya ba ni/ mtshams sbyar las/ bdag mdun gyi sogs/ bsam: rdor thal/ hoḥ dngos su 'byor dang sogs/ mchod: gsil/ rdor dril med par pad skor rang rgya/ oṃ badzra bha ra hi ha ri ṇi sa sa pa ri wa ra badzra arghaṃ sogs/ shabda rū pa sogs/ dharma sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha liṃ ta gu hya sarba pū dza khā hiḥ mchod rol/ sprul pa'i lha mo sogs/ bsam la: rtsa gdangs spyi phyag bcas/ hrīḥ ma bcos spros bral sogs/ hrīḥ ye nas sogs/ bka' brgyud bla ma sogs/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa sogs/ bstod par 'os pa sogs/ mchod rol lha mo rnams sogs/ gyur: mtshams sbyar bcas/ bskul pa chad brtan bro mnan yan rdzogs mthar/ tho bkrol/ gsol kha 'don zhing rten gtor mchod/ sa de nas mchod bstod/ bshags pa/ bsngo smon/ oṃ/ khyed kyis sems can sogs kyis mdun bskyed gshegs/ bsdu ldang*/ bkra shis sogs mtha' rgyas su bya zhing nub ja gsol/ 517) de ltar mtshams grol nas zhag gsum gyi bar gdan bsrung bya zhing*/ gtang rag gi las byang tshogs mchod kyang nyin gnyis kyi bar du byed dgos pas/ nyin dang por/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang*/ hūm̐ hrīḥ ma lus sems can sogs nas/ skye ba kun tu bar 'don zhing*/ de nas spyi gces sngon 'gro'i/ rang nyid skad cig gis sogs nas/ dza dzaḥ bar dang*/ mtshams sbyar las/ bsang chu/ mchod rdzas/ spos phyung yan dang*/ mkha' 'gro'i gsol 'debs/ skyabs yul bskyed pa gzhung gi skyabs sems gsum/ yan bdun/ maṇḍal/ tshogs zhing bsdu/ byin brlabs/ dkar gtor/ mtshams lha bskyed pa/

bgegs gtor byin brlabs/ 'gugs pa gsum/ bsngo ba gsum/ bka' bsgo sogs nas mtshams sbyar bcas/ bstod bshags bar dang*/ gsol 'debs/ 'dzab dmigs/ bsnyen bsgrub las sbyor rnams skabs dang bstun nas bzlas mthar/ shantiṃ puṣṭiṃ sogs nas/ mchod bstod/ dge bsngo bcas grub mthar/ nyin gung ja gsol/ de nas bshags pa bskang rjas bcas song rjes/ tshogs bsdus las/ ḍā 'ur/ ḍā bcas/ hrīḥ snang srid dag pa sogs/ klong grol shog: 518) oṃ badzra sarba hūm̐: btags pa'i bcu tshan rdzogs mtshams su/ yig brgya ḍā 'ur de'i 'gros kyis tshogs bskang brgya rtsa sogs grangs bsog nyin dang por lnga bcu tsam dang*/ nyin gnyis par lnga bcu/ khyon brgya rtsa tshun chad yin/ mthar ḍā 'ur bzhag thabs bya/ ye shes mkha' 'gro'i sogs/ tshogs mchod phul ba'i sogs/ bshags pa/ hoḥ dus gsum sangs rgyas sogs/ stsol: sa twa stong rtsa/ dam tshig nyams chags sogs/ nam mkha'i mthar thug sogs/ de nas tshogs byin brlabs/ spyan 'dren/ bdud rtsi 'bul ba/ bskang rdzas byin brlabs mthar/ bskang pa byin brlabs dbyig thob las/ ḍā bcas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: snang srid sogs/ rdzas su gyur: ḍā 'ur/ ḍā bcas/ hūm̐ hrīḥ 'og min sogs/ 'grub par shog: ḍā bcad nas bzhag rdor thal dril 'dzin/ hoḥ ye shes mkha' 'gro'i sogs/ mjug gi sngags dang*/ yig brgya lan gsum gyi tshe dril bu gsil mthar/ mchod rol/ bshags pa/ tshogs 'gugs/ bsgral bstab/ gnam phud/ drang ba/ bsam lhun che chung*/ lhag gtor byin brlabs/ lhag ma yan rdzogs rjes/ gsol kha 'don zhing*/ gsol rdzas dang*/ ba ling*/ skyu gu ci 519) 'dzoms/ gsol bsdus tshar grangs lnga bcu dang*/ nyin gnyis par lnga bcu chung tshad yin/ mtshams sbyar bcas/ bskul ba chad brtan sogs nas las mtha' rgyas su bya zhing*/ sku gsung thugs rten yod tshe bsdu rim rten bzhugs bya'o/ nyin gnyis pa la/ nang ja gsol mthar/ hūm̐ hrīḥ ma lus sems can

sogs nas/ skye ba kun tu bar dang*/ spyi gces sngon 'gro'i/ rang nyid skad cig sogs nas/ sa āḥhūm̐: bar dang*/ gnas dang mchod pa'i sogs gsol 'debs/ tshogs zhing bsdus pa/ skyabs sems nas/ sa maṇḍal yan dang*/ tshogs zhing bsdu/ nam mdzod sngags bcas/ dkar gtor/ mtshams lha bskyed pa dor zhing*/ oṃ hrī padma sogs/ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ tsam gyis chog bgegs gtor byin brlabs/ 'gugs bsngo/ bka' bsgo nas bzung mtshams sbyar dkyus gar bstod bshags 'dzab bzlas sogs kyi bar skabs dang bstun te/ mchod bstod dge bsngo bcas grub mthar gung ja gsol/ de nas bshags pa rdzas bskang tshogs bsdus sogs gong bzhin 'don/ tshogs byin rlabs sogs nas mtshams sbyar bcas 520) bskang bsdus bya zhing*/ lhag ma/ gsol kha yan rdzogs mthar/ 'gugs pa/ bskul ba/ chad tho/ brtan ma byin brlabs/ brtan ma/ bro 'gugs/ bro mnan/ gtor gzhong btegs pa/ 'di man chad mtshams sbyar dor la/ mchod bstod dngos grub sogs bkra shis yan grub mthar bsngo smon mtha' rgyas su bya'o/ nyin gsum par dkyil 'khor bshams bkod sogs kyi las rim rnams bsdus nas las rjes mi mngon par bya zhing*/ sa phyi dro dam tshig gtsang ba'i mi gcig gnyis tsam nang du gtong zhing*/ phyir nyin nas rim bzhin du gzhan rnams dang 'phrad par bya'o/ zhes pa 'di nyid chos bdag skye bu dam pa shes rab 'od zer gyis gtsos bu slob rnams dang*/ nye char shākya'i dge btsun ngag dbang nyi ma dang*/ khyad par dad dam 'chang ba lha rten nas dbang mdog 'dzin gyi phreng ba dang*/ lha reg dri bral bcas dus ring mo nas yang yang nan cher bskul ngor/ bsnyen sgrub ji ltar bgyi ba'i tshul gyis phyag bzhes 'bring po'i lugs ltar bde ba'i rdo rjes smras pa/ yig ris nan tan bgyi ba po rang gi nye gnas shākya'i dge btsun tshul khrims rdo rjes brtson 'grus kyi gzhu brdungs nas bsre bslad med par bris pa'i dge bas zab gter gyi bstan pa phyogs mthar rgyas pa'i rgyur gyur cig
